# Test Data Files

This directory contains small example genomic data files for testing and demonstration purposes.

## Files

- **example.bed** - BED format with genomic intervals
- **example.vcf** - VCF format with genetic variants  
- **example.gff** - GFF3 format with gene annotations
- **example.fasta** - FASTA format with DNA sequences
- **example.fastq** - FASTQ format with sequencing reads
- **example.sam** - SAM format with aligned reads
- **example.bam** - BAM format (binary SAM) with aligned reads
- **example.bam.bai** - BAM index file
